Galatasaray striker Victor Osimhen has been ranked fifth among the most valuable strikers playing outside Europe’s five major leagues, according to a study by the International Centre for Sports Studies.
The study ranked players by estimated transfer fees and placed the Nigerian at €53.7m. He is the only player from the Turkish Süper Lig in the top five.
Club Brugge’s Nicolo Tresoldi leads the list at €67.8m, followed by Benfica’s Vangelis Pavlidis at €61.2m, Sporting Lisbon’s Luis Suarez at €57.6m and Palmeiras’ Jose Manuel Lopez at €54.8m.
The 27-year-old has scored 10 goals and provided three assists in 11 official matches this season, a direct contribution to 13 goals. He is reported to earn €21m annually from the Turkish champions.
Osimhen’s season has been disrupted by injury. He hurt his knee in Galatasaray’s 2-0 Champions League win over VfB Stuttgart on November 3 and later underwent successful surgery.
The injury ruled him out of Nigeria’s 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers against Tanzania.
Galatasaray vice president Mehmet Cibara has described the problem as a long-standing one and dismissed suggestions that the club’s pitch was responsible.
